hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
mukund tiwari... solid name. where you working these days?
Primetrace Technologies Pvt. Ltd. in Bengaluru

primetrace technologies... haven't heard that name before, must be a smaller player. anyway, found you on linkedin - mukund tiwari, senior devops engineer at kutumb. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/mukund-tiwari-184203191

wait... you said primetrace but linkedin shows kutumb. which one's current?

senior devops engineer at kutumb... that's the social community platform right? building the infrastructure that keeps millions connected. solid work. what made you get into devops? was it the thrill of being woken up at 3am by alerts or just love for yaml files?

This current only. Primetrace is the parent company. 
We will rebrand the LinkedIn page soon.

ah gotcha, parent company situation. makes sense. 

so back to my question - what pulled you into the devops world? the constant firefighting or did you actually choose this chaos?
hey mukund, was just thinking about your devops journey at kutumb - what's the most satisfying part of building infrastructure for a social platform?
